battle.name: 智利獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 智利中部聖地亞哥谷地
battle.brief: 一八一〇年九月十八日聖地亞哥召開公開議會，愛國派推翻殖民當局，獨立戰爭開打；一八一四年蘭卡瓜慘敗，退入安第斯山；一八一七年聖馬丁率安第斯軍越嶺回師，一八一八年九月二十二日奧希金斯在馬伊普擊潰王軍。卡面這支一五二〇年的火繩槍是西班牙人帶進美洲的舊式火器，也是缺槍民兵僅存的底子。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 智利獨立戰爭寫在紙上是殖民地對宗主國的戰爭，實際是同一批智利人被兵役與效忠切成兩面。愛國派一側：一八一〇年九月十八日聖地亞哥召開公開議會，推翻殖民地政府，成立以馬特奧·德·托羅為首的政府會議；其後改組為中央最高委員會，再收攏成「至高專制政府」，軍政大權集中於聖地亞哥。愛國派的武裝核心是聖地亞哥行會民兵——騎兵團、炮兵團與按工匠行會編組的步卒民兵，槍械來自王室軍械庫與民間獵槍、刀劍農具，缺額就以長矛補上；一八一四年蘭卡瓜失敗後，隊伍退往安第斯山南麓，在阿根廷門多薩重組為安第斯軍，統制權在貝納爾多·奧希金斯與何塞·德·聖馬丁之間交接，最終以「第一線」部隊為骨幹演成國家軍隊。王室派一側的核心是西班牙王室任命的殖民地政府與常備守備軍：聖地亞哥龍騎兵團、團騎兵團與王室炮兵營，另有安東尼奧·金塔尼利亞於一八一〇年底帶著本土的任命抵達，以及一八一四年後由秘魯總督何塞·德·拉·塞爾納自利馬派出的援軍；一八一八年主戰的拉斐爾·馬羅托所部，則是本地守軍與秘魯王黨軍混編而成。兩軍基層多為克里奧羅、混血與原住民血統的智利人，分野在效忠對象，所以這場戰爭的殘酷並非殖民者對土著，而是同一批鄉里被陣營分割開來。
countriesEn: Written on paper, the Chilean War of Independence was a colony fighting its metropolitan power; in practice it was one and the same pool of Chileans cut in two by conscription and by allegiance. On the patriot side: on 18 September 1810 an open cabildo in Santiago deposed the colonial government and formed a governing junta under Mateo de Toro; that body was later reorganised into a central supreme junta and then tightened into a supreme director government that concentrated civil and military power in Santiago. The armed core of the patriots was the Santiago guild militia - cavalry, artillery, and foot militia organised by craft guild - whose weapons came from the royal arsenals plus civilian hunting guns, sabres and farm tools, with pikes making up whatever the shortfall. After the defeat at Rancagua in 1814 the column withdrew to the southern foot of the Andes and re-formed in Mendoza, Argentina, as the Army of the Andes, command passing from Bernardo O'Higgins to José de San Martín, and it eventually became the skeleton of a national army in the First Line. The royalist core was the colonial government appointed by the Spanish crown together with the standing garrison: the Santiago Dragoons, the Santiago Hussars and the royal artillery battalion, joined from late 1810 by Antonio Quintanilla, who arrived carrying the appointment made in metropolitan Spain, and by reinforcements sent from Lima under the viceroy José de la Serna after 1814; the force that fought at Maipú in 1818 under Rafael Maroto was a mixed body of local garrison troops and Peruvian royalists. At the rank and file both armies were overwhelmingly Chilean Creoles, mestizos and people of indigenous blood, and the dividing line was allegiance, so the horror of this war was not colonisers against natives but the same neighbours torn into opposing camps.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的有兩批人物。愛國派這邊，何塞·伊格納西奧·西恩富戈斯率聖地亞哥民兵在一八一一年一月一日的查克雷瓜斯之戰擊敗王室軍，讓政府議會在本土站穩腳跟；同年三月坎查拉亞達慘敗後，貝納爾多·奧希金斯接下軍隊，率軍在拉卡瓜亞達保住撤退通道，此後以至高專制政府之首的身份主持國家，並在一八一八年九月二十二日以馬伊普前線指揮官的身份收復首都。他的戰友何塞·德·聖馬丁是全場最專業的指揮官：一八一四年起在門多薩練兵整紀、籌措火藥與糧食，一八一七年率安第斯軍翻越安第斯山回師智利，一八一八年再率北線部隊包圍瓦爾迪維亞。兩人為權力分配與作戰優先次序多次不睦，馬丁甚至主張由奧希金斯留任政府而自己專赴前線，最後仍並肩打到獨立落實。愛國派內部另有胡安·米格爾·卡雷拉，他以反對中央權力、主張各省聯邦的名義另起爐竈，一八一三至一八一四年間在南部同政府軍衝突，一八一四年十二月在聖地亞哥被處決，死後反而成了反對個人獨裁的象徵。王室派這邊，安東尼奧·金塔尼利亞奉命回智利恢復王權，在巴爾帕萊索清洗之後仍被西恩富戈斯逐退，最後死在查卡布科；曼努埃爾·德·拉斯·埃拉斯在坎查拉亞達大破愛國軍，一八一四年又率王軍攻陷蘭卡瓜，其人於一八一五年在聖地亞哥近郊的一次遭遇戰中陣亡；拉斐爾·馬羅托則是馬伊普一役的皇家軍主將，撤退時把整支王軍帶向瓦解。愛國派陣中還有曼努埃爾·布爾內斯與迭戈·波塔萊斯等在獨立後重整智利軍政的關鍵人物，以及海軍方面的托馬斯·科克倫——這位出生於英格蘭的提督以封鎖海岸與奇洛埃登陸作戰，把皇家派的海上補給線切開。
peopleEn: Two sets of men decided how this war would go. On the patriot side, José Ignacio Cienfuegos led the Santiago militia at the battle of Quechereguas on 1 January 1811 and beat the royalist force, which allowed the governing junta to hold its ground in the colony; after the defeat at Cancha Rayada that March, Bernardo O'Higgins took over the army and kept the line of retreat open at Lacaughada, and thereafter presided over the state as head of the supreme director government before taking command of the front at Maipú on 22 September 1818 and retaking the capital. His comrade José de San Martín was the most professional commander on the field: from 1814 he drilled and disciplined the troops in Mendoza and arranged for powder, ammunition and grain, led the Army of the Andes over the Andes and back into Chile in 1817, and in 1818 took a northern column to the siege of Valdivia. The two men quarrelled repeatedly over the distribution of power and over priorities on the battlefield; Martín went so far as to argue that O'Higgins should stay in government while he took the field, and in the end they fought side by side until independence was won. Inside the patriot camp there was also Juan Miguel Carrera, who raised a separate banner against central authority and for a federation of provinces, clashed with the government forces in the south between 1813 and 1814, and was executed in Santiago in December 1814 - after which he became a symbol of resistance to personal dictatorship. On the royalist side, Antonio Quintanilla had been sent to restore royal authority in Chile, was driven out by Cienfuegos after the purge at Valparaíso, and was killed at Chacabuco; Manuel de las Heras crushed the patriots at Cancha Rayada and marched into Rancagua in 1814, and was killed in an encounter near Santiago in 1815; Rafael Maroto commanded the royalist army at Maipú and led it into dissolution during the retreat. The patriot ranks later produced the men who rebuilt Chile's military and civil administration, such as Manuel Bulnes and Diego Portales, while at sea Thomas Cochrane, the British-born admiral, blockaded the coast and fought the landing on Chiloé, cutting the royalist sea supply line.
kits: 卡面上這件一五二〇年的西班牙火繩槍銃，是這場戰爭的技術起點，卻不是馬伊普火線上的主力。一五二〇年前後，西班牙把火繩槍（mosquete de mecha）列為步兵制式裝備：槍身比輕型火繩槍更長更重，射擊時要架在叉形支架上，用浸油的慢燃繩點火，每分鐘只能打出一兩發，遇雨便失效——卡面那句「要點火、要瞄、要排隊」講的正是這件事。它在十六世紀的歐洲以整齊方陣的排射聞名，隨哥倫布與征服者進入美洲，成為西屬殖民地守備軍與民兵庫裡最耐用的舊式火器。然而到一八一〇年，這類火器已被燧發槍（pedronial、espadrín）取代了近兩百年，只在偏遠的皇家軍備庫、地方民兵與鄉村自保武裝手中殘存，數量稀少、彈藥難繼，偶爾被整備後配給缺槍的義勇軍。真正上陣的是愛國派的燧發步槍、卡賓槍、獵槍（escopeta）與大刀，配以長矛（pica）、南美騎士的長矛（lanza）、套索與投球（bolas）；安第斯軍步兵以燧發槍為主但比例不足，缺槍者持矛列陣，騎兵配馬刀與短槍。炮兵方面，皇家軍有十二磅、八磅的野戰砲與輕型炮架，愛國軍在聖地亞哥只有少量老砲，到馬伊普一役以何塞·隆迪索尼主持的炮兵營為核心，十門上下。攻城與爆破同樣是這場戰爭的常規手段：圍城用壕溝、木造雲梯與炮擊，奇洛埃與瓦爾迪維亞靠海陸夾擊；一八一四年十月蘭卡瓜的最後一幕，是退守阿爾馬森·德·拉·科魯尼亞的守軍以火藥庫自身炸毀建築與全軍。運輸則靠騾隊、牛車與馬匹：安第斯軍出發時帶走逾萬頭騾，穿越冰河與山口；海路恢復後，糧食與火藥由瓦爾帕萊索的船運往中部，皇家軍沿海的撤退也全賴這條海運線。
kitsEn: The matchlock musket of 1520 shown on the card is the technical starting point of this war, but it was not the weapon firing on the Maipú field. Around 1520 Spain made the matchlock musket (mosquete de mecha) standard infantry equipment: longer and heavier than the light arquebus, it had to be rested on a forked rest, fired from an oil-soaked slow match, managed one or two shots a minute, and became useless in rain - which is exactly what the card's line about needing to light, aim and stand in ranks is describing. Renowned in sixteenth-century Europe for its orderly massed volleys, it travelled to America with Columbus and the conquistadors and became the most durable old arm in the arsenals of the Spanish colonial garrisons and militias. By 1810, however, the type had been superseded by the flintlock (pedronial, espadrín) for close to two centuries, and survived only in remote royal arsenals, in local militias and in village self-defence bands, few in number and short of ammunition, occasionally cleaned up and handed to volunteers who had no gun at all. What actually fought was the patriot flintlock infantry musket, the carbine, the hunting gun (escopeta) and the machete, supported by the pike, the lancer's lance (lanza), the lasso and the bolas; in the Army of the Andes flintlocks were the main arm but never numerous enough, so men without guns marched with pikes, while the cavalry carried sabres and short carbines. On the artillery side the royalists fielded twelve- and eight-pounder guns on light carriages, while the patriots had only a few old pieces in Santiago and came to Maipú with a battery of about ten guns under the Italian artillery chief José Rondizzoni. Siege and demolition were routine in this war as well: trenches, wooden ladders and bombardment for blockhouses, and combined land and sea assault against Chiloé and Valdivia. The last scene at Rancagua in October 1814 was a patriot detachment that had retired into the Almacén de la Coruña blowing the magazine up with the whole post inside. Transport depended on mule trains, ox carts and horses: the Army of the Andes took more than ten thousand mules on the march, crossing glaciers and passes, and once the sea lane reopened, grain and powder were shipped from Valparaíso to the central provinces, while the royalist withdrawal along the coast hung on the same route.
tactics: 愛國派起義初期的打法是民兵式的：聖地亞哥行會民兵排成密集縱隊正面硬壓，遇排射的守軍就靠人數與地形硬拼，談不上炮兵、騎兵與步兵的配合。真正改掉這個毛病的是一八一四年之後在門多薩重建的安第斯軍。聖馬丁把隊伍明確分成步兵縱隊、騎兵、炮兵與工兵，定下不許劫掠、軍民分帳、繳獲歸公的紀律，解決了愛國派長期打完就散、兵變不斷的痼疾；翻越安第斯山時把大縱隊拆成數支小縱隊分走不同山口，規定互相以鐘聲與烽火聯絡，除他本人發出的信號外一律不得前進，違令者視同叛變。這種嚴格到極點的指揮控制，是安第斯軍能連續作戰的前提。一八一七年二月十二日的查卡布科，靠的是小股先鋒的奇襲與山道地形，皇家軍騎兵一旦潰散就回身劫掠自己的營帳，聖馬丁不追遠而是收攏部隊重整，隨後才讓騎兵咬住潰兵。一八一四年十月一日至二日蘭卡瓜則相反：愛國軍佔據城鎮街區節點逐屋抵抗，王室軍以密集縱隊衝鋒並在馬爾梅杜山以炮兵掩護，最後被逼入阿爾馬森·德·拉·科魯尼亞的守軍以火藥同歸於盡。一八一八年九月二十二日馬伊普，愛國軍天未亮即發動進攻，左翼在拉努斯山一帶的高地與葡萄園、灌溉渠構成掩體，騎兵在後方待命，步兵以縱隊逐次投入，死亡輕騎兵營以刺刀衝鋒奪取敵方砲位；王軍崩潰時未及破壞糧秣，愛國軍在同一條退路上截住潰兵，收繳的槍械、火藥與糧食正是此後國家軍隊的主要家底。海上則由科克倫的艦隊封鎖海岸、攻擊奇洛埃，切斷王室的沿海補給。
tacticsEn: The patriots began with militia-style fighting: the Santiago guild militia marched in dense columns and simply pushed with numbers and terrain against troops firing in ranks, with no real cooperation between artillery, cavalry and foot. What really cured that fault was the Army of the Andes, rebuilt in Mendoza after 1814. San Martín divided the force explicitly into infantry columns, cavalry, artillery and engineers, and laid down a discipline of no plundering, separate company and public accounts, and all booty turned in to the stores - which cured the patriot habit of melting away after every battle and of mutiny. On the crossing of the Andes he split the main body into small columns taking different passes, ordered them to keep in touch by bells and beacon fires, forbade any advance without the signal issued by himself, and treated disobedience as treason. That extreme command control is what let the Army of the Andes fight continuously. The battle of Chacabuco on 12 February 1817 rested on a surprise blow by a small vanguard and on the broken ground of the mountain road; once the royalist cavalry broke, it turned back to plunder its own baggage, and San Martín refused to chase far, instead closing up and reforming his troops and only then sending the cavalry after the fugitives. Rancagua on 1 and 2 October 1814 was the opposite: the patriots held street junctions of the town and fought house by house, the royalists charged in dense columns with artillery support from the hill of Marimela, and the survivors were driven into the Almacén de la Coruña to go up with the powder. At Maipú on 22 September 1818 the patriot attack opened before dawn; the left wing used the heights around the hill of Lanos together with the vineyards and irrigation ditches as cover, the cavalry waited in the rear, the infantry was fed in column by column, and the Death's Hussars charged with the bayonet to take the enemy gun position. When the royalist line broke it had no time to destroy its baggage, and the patriots cut the fugitives off on the very road they were taking, so that the muskets, powder and grain they took became the main stock of the future national army. At sea Cochrane's squadron blockaded the coast and attacked Chiloé, cutting the royalist supply line along the shore.
data: 先記下確定的日期：一八一〇年九月十八日聖地亞哥公開議會；一八一一年一月一日查克雷瓜斯；一八一一年三月四日坎查拉亞達；一八一四年十月一日至二日蘭卡瓜；一八一七年二月十二日查卡布科；一八一八年九月二十二日馬伊普；一八一八年十月二十八日奇洛埃守軍投降；一八一八年十一月二十二日公布臨時憲法；一八一九年瓦爾迪維亞陷落；一八二二年三月奧希金斯去職；一八二三年二月八日頒布共和國憲章。兵力方面，一八一二至一八一三年的人口清點，智利總人口約五十萬上下；安第斯軍出發時約三千人，隨軍騾馬逾萬頭，行程三百公里上下、連續行軍數週；查克雷瓜斯一役雙方都是數千人規模。蘭卡瓜守軍退入火藥庫後同歸於盡者，記載多在數百人。馬伊普一役的兵力各家估計出入頗大，概數是王軍約兩千人上下（有記載稱近三千）、愛國軍約三千至四千人，炮兵方面王軍十餘門、愛國軍約六門，愛國軍以傷者為多，軍官陣亡數十人。瓦爾迪維亞守軍約一千三百人，奇洛埃守軍在千餘人上下。到一八一九年，王室在智利的野戰部隊基本被清空，殘餘退往南部山區與海岸據點，零星抵抗一直延續到一八二〇年代。這些數字多來自事後的官修史與回憶錄，彼此常常打架，只能當作概數看待。
dataEn: The firm dates first: the open cabildo at Santiago on 18 September 1810; Quechereguas on 1 January 1811; Cancha Rayada on 4 March 1811; Rancagua on 1 and 2 October 1814; Chacabuco on 12 February 1817; Maipú on 22 September 1818; the surrender of the Chiloé garrison on 28 October 1818; the publication of the provisional constitution on 22 November 1818; the fall of Valdivia in 1819; O'Higgins leaving office in March 1822; the charter of the republic on 8 February 1823. On numbers of men: the population count of 1812 to 1813 puts the total population of Chile at about half a million; the Army of the Andes set out with roughly three thousand men and more than ten thousand mules, over a route of some three hundred kilometres marched in weeks; at Quechereguas both sides numbered in the thousands. The patriots who went up with the powder in the magazine at Rancagua are usually put at several hundred. Estimates of the strengths at Maipú differ widely between sources: roughly two thousand royalists on the royalist side (some accounts say close to three thousand) against about three to four thousand patriots, with a dozen or so royalist guns facing some six patriot guns, and patriot casualties mostly wounded, with several dozen officers killed. The garrison of Valdivia was about thirteen hundred men, and the Chiloé garrison on the order of a thousand and more. By 1819 the royalist field army in Chile had been essentially emptied, the survivors falling back into the southern mountains and the coastal strongholds, with scattered resistance lasting into the 1820s. These figures come mostly from official histories written after the event and from memoirs, and they often contradict one another, so they should be read as rough numbers only.
cause: 一八一〇年之前的智利並不是沒有人想過自治，而是沒有人相信中央會放手。三個背景疊在一起。其一，拿破崙戰爭把西班牙本土捲入半島戰事，一八一〇年國王斐迪南七世退位、王位空缺，被囚的西班牙人在國內反對派援引美國獨立與法國革命的說法，要求殖民地效忠國民議會；七月二十六日的雷加斯-卡瓦涅斯自由法令更把海外公民與原本屬於西班牙國籍的海外居民在法律上分開，讓海外殖民地可以自行設立議會。智利人讀到這條法令時得到的訊息是：宗主國已經沒有能力管我們了。其二，西屬美洲的克里奧羅知識分子在啟蒙讀物與克里奧羅主義影響下，開始主張本地出生的精英應在本地受職、本地的事務應由本地人治理；到一八一〇年，智利已經有聖地亞哥商會與工匠行會的實力做支撐。其三，英國封鎖西屬美洲港口，戰時物價與銀價的波動，讓商團感到航運與外貿的風險正在累積。壓力最終在形式上爆開：新任總督抵達的消息傳到聖地亞哥，市政當局為迎接總督而召開公開議會，議會卻在會場上宣讀起義文書，成立政府會議，王室總督安東尼奧·昆塔尼利亞被拘於巴爾帕萊索要塞。起義因此不是密謀的結果，而是議會程序被一次群眾集會扭轉的結果。
causeEn: Before 1810 Chileans were not unaware of the idea of self-government; what they lacked was any belief that the centre would let go. Three backgrounds ran together. First, the Napoleonic wars dragged metropolitan Spain into the Peninsular conflict; in 1810 King Ferdinand VII abdicated and the throne stood empty, and Spaniards held in custody pressed the American and French revolutionary example on the home government, demanding that the colonies owe allegiance to the national assembly; the Regla de Franquicia of 26 July separated in law the overseas Spaniards from the nationals resident overseas, allowing overseas colonies to set up their own assemblies. The message Chilean readers took from that decree was that the mother country no longer had the power to govern them. Second, Creole intellectuals in Spanish America, fed by Enlightenment books and by criollismo, began to argue that locally born elites should hold office locally and that local affairs should be handled by local men; by 1810 Chile had the material strength behind such claims in the merchant guild and the craft guilds of Santiago. Third, the British blockade of the Spanish American ports and the wartime swings in prices and silver made the trading houses feel the risk of shipping and foreign trade accumulating. The pressure finally burst in a formal way: word of the arriving new governor reached Santiago, the town council called an open cabildo to welcome him, and the assembly instead read out a revolutionary text, formed a governing junta, and the royal governor Antonio Quintanilla was detained in the fortress of Valparaíso. The rising was therefore not the result of a conspiracy but the result of parliamentary procedure turned inside out by a single public meeting.
impact: 獨立帶來的是一套新國家機器，而不只是一面新旗幟。奧希金斯一八一九至一八二二年的執政期內以土地獎賞安置退伍軍人，整頓聖地亞哥造幣廠、嘗試改革幣制，並把教會地產與礦業收益納入國家財政，這些做法把戰後的軍隊與財政連成一體，同時留下長期爭議的教產問題。一八二三年二月八日的共和國憲章確立了共和原則與信仰自由，卻仍保留極強的教會影響力。此後數十年，智利是南美最早建立常備軍與統一司法體系的國家之一；一八二六年與英國簽訂自由貿易條約，港口開放與英國資本進入，使智利在十九世紀末成為太平洋沿岸經濟最穩定的國家之一。制度層面留下兩道最深的刻痕：其一，軍隊作為國家強制力的核心被保留下來並制度化，日後在一八三六至一八三九年的聯邦戰爭與一八七九至一八八四年的太平洋戰爭中，智利軍隊屢次以少數兵力對抗更強的鄰國軍隊而保住戰役記錄；其二，一八三一年迭戈·波塔萊斯遇刺後，他整理軍制與行政的事業由後人接續，一八三三年憲法確立的中央集權模式一直延續到二十世紀。回頭看，這場一八一〇至一八二三年的戰爭，決定了智利以一個共和國而不是西班牙美洲的一個省份的形態存在。
impactEn: Independence brought a new state machinery, not merely a new flag. During O'Higgins's government of 1819 to 1822 the veterans were settled on land grants, the mint at Santiago was reorganised and an attempt was made to reform the coinage, and church property and mining revenue were pulled into the treasury; these measures tied the post-war army to the post-war finances, and they also left behind the long-running question of church lands. The charter of the republic of 8 February 1823 set out republican principles and religious freedom while keeping a very strong clerical influence. In the decades that followed Chile was among the first countries in South America to build a standing army and a unified judiciary; the free trade treaty with Britain of 1826 and the opening of the ports to British capital made Chile one of the most economically stable countries on the Pacific rim by the late nineteenth century. Two marks were left deepest in the institutions. First, the army as the core of state coercive power was preserved and institutionalised, and in the federal war of 1836 to 1839 and the War of the Pacific of 1879 to 1884 the Chilean forces repeatedly held their campaigns against larger neighbouring armies with smaller numbers of men. Second, after Diego Portales was assassinated in 1831 his work of reorganising the army and the administration was carried on by others, and the centralised model fixed by the 1833 constitution ran on into the twentieth century. Looking back, the war of 1810 to 1823 decided the form in which Chile existed: as a republic, not as a province of Spanish America.
result: 一八一〇年九月十八日的那場集會只換了聖地亞哥的一小群人，戰爭卻打了十二年。過程是一連串起伏：一八一〇年九月十八日議會推翻當局；一八一〇年十二月的巴爾帕萊索慘案與一八一一年一月的查克雷瓜斯；一八一一年三月的坎查拉亞達敗局迫使政府遷移並把奧希金斯推上軍權位置；一八一四年十月的蘭卡瓜幾乎把剛剛成形的新軍打散，首都淪陷，奧希金斯被俘送往利馬囚禁，殘部退入安第斯山；一八一七年二月查卡布科收復智利中部；一八一八年九月二十二日馬伊普一役，奧希金斯指揮的愛國軍正面擊潰拉斐爾·馬羅托的王軍，聖馬丁的北線部隊同步包圍瓦爾迪維亞；一八一八年十月奇洛埃守軍投降，一八一九年瓦爾迪維亞淪陷，王室在智利中部與南部的野戰力量基本被清空，殘餘退往邊地與海岸堡壘，零星抵抗一直延續到一八二〇年代。一八二二年三月奧希金斯辭去最高執政官，政權轉入共和憲章的框架。結局因此是分裂的：殖民地時代的秩序在中部被徹底終結，國王費爾南多七世的名義在南美洲的權威只剩下秘魯、玻利維亞與古巴等地；對智利自身而言，這場戰爭贏下的是國家的存續，代價是財政枯竭、壯丁耗損，以及把新國家牢牢綁在秩序與教會之上的保守結構。
resultEn: The meeting of 18 September 1810 changed only a small group of men in Santiago, yet the war ran for twelve years. The course was a series of surges and reversals: the cabildo of September 1810 overthrew the authorities; the Valparaíso purge of December 1810 and Quechereguas in January 1811; the defeat at Cancha Rayada in March 1811, which drove the government to move and pushed O'Higgins into military command; the battle of Rancagua in October 1814, which very nearly dissolved the newly formed army, cost the capital, and sent O'Higgins a prisoner to Lima while the remnants fell back into the Andes; Chacabuco in February 1817 recovered the centre of Chile; at Maipú on 22 September 1818 the patriot army under O'Higgins broke Rafael Maroto's royalist force in the open field while San Martín's northern column closed in on Valdivia; the Chiloé garrison surrendered in October 1818; Valdivia fell in 1819, by which time the royalist field forces in central and southern Chile had been effectively emptied, the survivors retiring to frontier and coastal strongholds where scattered resistance ran on into the 1820s. In March 1822 O'Higgins laid down the office of supreme director and the government passed into the framework of the republican charter. The ending is therefore a divided one: the colonial order was ended outright in the centre, and the authority of King Ferdinand VII in South America survived only in Peru, Bolivia and Cuba; for Chile itself what the war won was the survival of the country, and what it cost was an exhausted treasury, the loss of the flower of the manpower, and a conservative structure that tied the new state firmly to order and to the Church.
